mapper.sql: subscription_id, reg_order_no, owner_student_id, center_code, bill_key, card_name, card_no, status, anchor_day, next_billing_on, billing_cycle_from, first_billing_on, last_paid_at, fail_count, last_fail_reason
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_subscription (reg_order_no, owner_student_id, center_code, first_billing_on, status, card_reg_at, created_at) VALUES (#{regOrderNo}, #{ownerStudentId}, #{centerCode}, #{firstBillingOn}, 'PENDING', DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()), DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()))

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_subscription_member (subscription_id, student_id, product_id, service_code, status, joined_at) VALUES (#{subscriptionId}, #{studentId}, #{productId}, #{serviceCode}, 'PENDING', DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()))
mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 FROM erp_bookstore_subscription WHERE owner_student_id = #{studentId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED') ORDER BY subscription_id DESC

SELECT TOP 1 s.subscription_id, s.reg_order_no, s.owner_student_id, s.center_code, s.bill_key, s.card_name, s.card_no, s.status, s.anchor_day, s.next_billing_on, s.billing_cycle_from, s.first_billing_on, s.last_paid_at, s.fail_count, s.last_fail_reason FROM erp_bookstore_subscription s JOIN erp_bookstore_subscription_member m ON m.subscription_id = s.subscription_id WHERE m.student_id = #{studentId} AND m.service_code = #{serviceCode} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED') ORDER BY s.subscription_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_subscription SET bill_key = #{billKey}, card_name = #{cardName}, card_no = #{cardNo}, anchor_day = #{anchorDay}, next_billing_on = #{nextBillingOn}, billing_cycle_from = #{billingCycleFrom}, status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE erp_bookstore_subscription_member SET status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM erp_bookstore_subscription WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND next_billing_on IS NOT NULL AND next_billing_on <= #{today} ORDER BY next_billing_on, subscription_id
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_subscription SET billing_cycle_from = #{nextCycleFrom}, last_paid_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()), fail_count = 0, last_fail_reason = NULL WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId}
UPDATE erp_bookstore_subscription SET status = 'ACTIVE', fail_count = 0, last_fail_reason = NULL, next_billing_on = #{nextBillingOn} WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} AND status = 'PAUSED'
UPDATE erp_bookstore_subscription SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED')
UPDATE erp_bookstore_subscription_member SET status = 'REMOVED', removed_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE')
UPDATE erp_bookstore_subscription SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND card_reg_at < #{cutoff}
